source: Working translation by the pack's own contributor. The chart of accounts approved by Order No. 353-N of the Minister of Finance (17 April 2012) is published in Armenian only; no official English version was found. The VAT return form and the Tax Code have an English rendering only for the Tax Code (arlis.am), which is a translation, not the authentic text. This file is therefore a working translation, not an official English version. See i18n/README.md.
